newsitem.title: FINLAND: Vaisala sees sales up, good profitability.
newsitem.headline: Vaisala sees sales up, good profitability.

text.p: Finnish meteorological equipment maker Vaisala Oy said on Monday its 1997 sales would go on growing and profitability would remain good.
"The prospects for 1997 are good. The growth in sales will continue and profitability will remain good," Vaisala said in a statement with its 1996 results.
"Increased efforts into research will be reflected in better products and a more extensive product range in the future," it said.
Last year, sales grew in all divisions and exceeded the company's own targets, Vaisala said.
Group net sales rose 18 percent to 493 million markka. Profit before extraordinary items and tax rose to 112 million markka from 90 million in 1995.
